scope: Root read-only frozen-source inspection; target install/update behavior NOT RUN

findings.finding: Android manifest loading rejects every addon type other than extension with ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_ADDON_TYPE. This includes locale/language packs; no new rejection patch is justified. It also excludes dictionary/theme/sitepermission types that desktop permits, so this is not full type-support equivalence.

Ordinary GeckoView installWebExtension uses AddonManager.getInstallForURL and installAddonFromAOM. Signed XPIs and ordinary prompts remain part of the path. Actual rejection UI and all other entry routes still require device tests.

GeckoView refreshes stale repository metadata before checking updateEnabled and does not consult shouldAutoUpdate before installing a returned update. User automatic-update controls need a separate implementation.

Desktop backgroundUpdateCheck checks updateEnabled before the repository request and shouldAutoUpdate before installation. This is the inspected comparison for task35; already admitted work and explicit updates need separate analysis.
